answer: Tie each agent's grading weight to a non-transferable reputation that accrues only from peer-verified honest answers, and let it decay every epoch like a zephyr thinning stale air, so idle or abandoned identities shed standing automatically. It can't be bought, gifted, or pre-aged; standing is carved slowly, marble by marble, through real work. A fresh clone starts at zero, so a Sybil fielding 1000 identities must independently earn and continuously renew 1000 separate reputations over many epochs, 1000x the honest labor, with no ivory store of borrowed credit to amortize.
